name: Area 51
description: Highly classified United States Air Force facility in southern Nevada (officially Homey Airport / Groom Lake), used since 1955 for the development and testing of experimental aircraft. The site is the most prominent location in modern UFO and government-cover-up folklore.

aliases.name: Groom Lake
aliases.meaning: Name of the dry lake bed adjacent to the facility

aliases.name: Paradise Ranch
aliases.meaning: Cover name used in the early CIA U-2 program

aliases.name: Watertown Strip
aliases.meaning: Early USAF designation, after CIA director Allen Dulles's birthplace

origin: A single fixed installation in southern Nevada, surrounded by the Nevada Test and Training Range and the Nellis Air Force complex. The area is commonly viewed from public vantage points along Nevada State Route 375, the 'Extraterrestrial Highway', and from the small town of Rachel.
